scientific_question: How much of the post-submission performance difference can be attributed to a portable EEG task-adaptation and calibration layer rather than to changing the base model?
hypothesis: A frozen schema-guided inference-time adapter plus development-only post-hoc calibration will improve Mistral certainty alignment and structured consistency while preserving the submitted model weights and untouched evaluation surfaces.

signals.note: Historical first-100 Zoe RA development boundary described in the thesis; exact membership is governed by its immutable manifest.
Clinical definitions, annotation semantics, and deterministic label relationships may shape the task interface without exposing evaluation outcomes.
Reviewer requests may determine which uncertainty and sensitivity analyses are reported, but not select a winning configuration from evaluation results.
The 1,395-report Zoe evaluation surface remains untouched until adapter freeze; its exact membership is governed by its manifest.
The 499-report Maria evaluation surface remains untouched until adapter freeze; its exact membership is governed by its manifest.
Exact v5g predictions, when received, are comparison evidence and may not teach or select this Mistral adapter.
Awareness of provisional aggregates motivates a transportability question but cannot define thresholds, stopping, or variant choice.

freeze.selection_rule: Use only the historical first-100 Zoe development manifest, declared domain knowledge, and prespecified consistency criteria; retain every attempted variant and unfavorable development result.
freeze.stopping_rule: Freeze after the prespecified component ablation and calibration procedure completes on the development surface; do not continue after inspecting Zoe or Maria evaluation outcomes.

evaluation.attribution_scope: The primary same-model contrast may estimate the task-layer effect only when Mistral artifact, quantization, runtime, and report surface are otherwise held fixed.
evaluation.medgemma_comparison_scope: Adapted Mistral versus v5g MedGemma is an overall-configuration comparison, not a base-model or adapter effect, until both adapters are transported across both base models in a frozen factorial design.

claim_boundary: Matching or exceeding MedGemma is a hypothesis, not a configuration-selection rule. This plan creates no result and does not alter submitted or reproduced Mistral evidence.
privacy_boundary: The public plan contains no report text, report or patient key, case-level prediction, model weight, or governed manifest.
